caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, wooden-framed wall clock with a polished, reddish-brown wood grain appearance. The clock face is circular, white, and features black Roman numerals marking the hours, with black minute and hour hands and a round, golden mechanical feature visible in the center near the hands' pivot. The outer edge of the clock face is decorated with a floral motif that includes green leaves and pink flowers arranged symmetrically at the top left, top right, bottom left, and bottom right. Below the clock face, centered in the lower half of the frame, there is a rectangular painted panel showing a townscape. This panel depicts a fenced grassy area with shrubbery in the foreground; behind the fence, there are several buildings, including a large, multi-story rectangular building on the left, smaller buildings in the center and right, and two church spires, with one prominent tall steeple and another shorter spire. The sky above the buildings is a gradient of light blue. The entire composition is enclosed within a drawn outline of the clock and its frame that is slightly offset from the image itself, with faint measurement markings and text at the bottom right corner reading "Vincent Rosel Del 156-1" and "G. Saltar."
title: Thirty Hour Clock
